name: AnythingLLM
tagline: All-in-one desktop and self-hosted workspace for chatting with local documents using built-in RAG and vector storage.
real_test_summary: Tested ingesting PDF manuals and markdown notes into isolated local workspaces using the bundled LanceDB vector store. Answers stay grounded in uploaded documents completely offline.
pros: Includes built-in embedder and LanceDB vector database out of the box
Desktop installer eliminates Docker setup for local document chat
Supports multi-user workspaces and custom local agent skills
cons: Desktop bundle consumes noticeable disk space when downloading built-in models
Advanced multi-user permission controls require self-hosted Docker mode
